etsy.title: Senior Night Poster | Custom Sports Wall Art From Your Photos | Class of 2026 Senior Gift | Any Sport | Digital Download
etsy.description:
One last home game. Four years of practices, bus rides and buzzer-beaters — and one night to honor all of it. This is the senior night gift that outlasts the flowers: a personalized poster built from your own photos of your senior, in a gold SENIOR NIGHT edition made for the occasion.

━━━━━━ THE SENIOR NIGHT EDITION ━━━━━━

• Champagne-gold ceremony style: the arena, the confetti, the spotlight — their last home game, made forever
• CLASS OF 2026 lockup and career years (FR–SR) on the poster
• Two print sizes: 18x24 and 24x36, both true 300 DPI

━━━━━━ WHAT YOU GET — 18 FILES ━━━━━━

POSTER
• 18x24 in and 24x36 in poster files, print-ready 300 DPI

SOCIAL & SCREENS
• 9 social media files (grid posts, stories, reel cover, profile picture, cover banner)
• 7 wallpapers for phone, tablet and desktop

━━━━━━ EVERY SENIOR HAS A SPORT ━━━━━━

Football, cheerleading, soccer, volleyball, basketball, baseball, softball, ice hockey, lacrosse, wrestling, gymnastics, track & field, swimming, tennis, golf, pickleball. Don't see yours? Choose Other and write it in the box — we build it.

━━━━━━ SENIOR NIGHT IS ON THE CALENDAR ━━━━━━

Senior night has a date, and it doesn't move. Order with your photos ready and we send the reference for your approval first — you see your senior before anything is finished. Digital delivery through Etsy, no shipping to wait on.

━━━━━━ HOW YOUR SET IS MADE — OUR 6-STEP PROCESS ━━━━━━

Your athlete is not a photo dropped into a template. We build a new image of them.

1 · PHOTO CHECK. We review the photos you send and tell you straight away if anything won't work.
2 · KIT BUILD. We reconstruct the uniform, club crest and colours for your sport.
3 · REFERENCE PLATE. We create and lock one reference of your athlete — face, build, hair, kit. You approve it before we go on.
4 · THE SHOTS. Every pose inherits that locked reference, so all of them are the same person.
5 · VERIFICATION. We measure the face match numerically and check every mark on the kit against the reference.
6 · FINISH. The approved frames are composed into the poster, cards and files.

━━━━━━ HOW TO ORDER ━━━━━━

1. Choose the sport above — SENIOR NIGHT gold is the edition, so there is no art-style picker on this listing
2. Add your senior's name, number, team, class year — and their senior quote if you'd like it on the card back
3. Upload 4-10 photos
4. We send the reference for approval before anything else is made
5. Your files arrive through Etsy — no physical item ships

━━━━━━ PHOTOS THAT WORK BEST ━━━━━━

• 4 to 10 photos, the more the better
• High resolution — not blurry when you zoom in
• Face clearly visible, good light, no heavy filters
• At least one full-body photo, head to feet
• If possible, one in the team's kit
• Team crest or logo as a separate image if you have it

━━━━━━ AI DISCLOSURE ━━━━━━

These images are created with AI image tools, directed by our own prompts and our own six-step process. Every frame is reviewed, corrected and approved by a human before anything is delivered. Results depend on the photos you send.

━━━━━━ GOOD TO KNOW ━━━━━━

• We never reproduce real league or brand marks (NFL, FIFA, NCAA, Olympic, or sportswear logos). Your school or club's own crest, yes — a licensed league mark, never.
• DIGITAL DELIVERY ONLY. No physical item ships with this listing.
• Your photos are used for your order only and are deleted on request.
